description: Read cached earnings-call paragraphs for one exact Bullrun ticker, optionally filtered by fiscal period or search text. A best-effort free background import collects at most the two latest retained calls from DefeatBeta for supported US listings, with a 24-hour stored-data cooldown; the first read may be empty. Coverage and source publication lag vary. Speaker names and paragraph order are retained; roles and prepared/Q&A section labels may be unavailable. Does not change portfolios or user data.

maxCharsPerChunk.description: Maximum characters per transcript chunk in the MCP response.

maxChunks.description: Maximum speaker-tagged transcript chunks to return.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive text/speaker search across transcript chunks.

ticker.description: Bullrun ticker, e.g. "CRWD", "SPGI", "V". Use the listing ticker returned by search_stocks. US/European examples: AAPL, BMW, NESN. Most Asian listings keep their exchange suffix (6324.T, 0700.HK); some use bare codes (005930). Native or suffixed forms resolve only when one listing matches; search by company name or ISIN if unsure.

name: get_earnings_call_transcript
title: Get earnings call transcript
